mode: phase2c scope-negative runtime matrix (real MCP Streamable HTTP, SDK runtime — NOT host)

source.provenance: Recomputable from the current worktree by starting isolated in-process MCP servers on loopback with a temp vault/data path. `commit` is the pre-generation HEAD and is informational only; the content digest excludes this `source` block.

transport: MCP Streamable HTTP over 127.0.0.1 ephemeral port
authHarness: test middleware maps x-test-scopes -> authInfo.scopes; this is NOT production authentication
notHostEvidence: This is SDK/runtime transport evidence. It does not prove any installed host defers tool loading or refreshes its tool list. Host cells stay `unknown`.

annotationScopeMismatch.note: Frozen fixtures classify some tasks as read-only while the tool's Scope requirement includes obsidian.write. This census records the mismatch; it does not change the frozen fixtures or the Scope truth.

semantics.deniedHandlerExecutions: Every registered handler is wrapped with a sentinel counter. The matrix only calls tools that are expected to be hidden; a nonzero count means a denied call reached a handler.
semantics.metadataLeaks: structuralLeaks counts returned tool names outside the independently computed expected set; hiddenNameInPayload counts expected-hidden names that leaked into the returned `name` field.

unmeasured: installed host deferred loading / tool search (Phase 3 host evidence)
